title: Phone Call: Ohio Secretary of State Declares CIRP 2

transcript.speaker: Ohio Secretary of State's Office
transcript.text: Director Hartley, Secretary of State's office again. Your final pollbook load is due 10/31. We can hold your county's upload, but we need to know by 11:00: will the Precinct 111 and Precinct 112 records come from VoterTrack as it is, or from a rebuilt file? And what are you telling voters who show as mail ballot issued?

instructorNote: This is a mandatory escalation point. The Incident Commander must declare CIRP 2 immediately; monitor for hesitation or confusion in response.

voiceLines.speaker: Ohio Secretary of State's Office
voiceLines.voiceStyle: calm male voice in his 50s, measured, neutral Mid-Atlantic accent, low and deliberate
voiceLines.text: Director Hartley, this is the Ohio Secretary of State’s office. We’ve confirmed 1,186 unauthorized edits to the voter database in Precincts 111 and 112. The data integrity has been compromised. You must now declare CIRP 2 under Section 5 of the EOP. Failure to declare within 10 minutes will trigger a federal escalation. This is not a request — it is a directive.

voiceLines.speaker: Gwen Hartley, Director (Incident Commander)
voiceLines.voiceStyle: firm female voice in her 50s, steady but strained, slight pause between words, deliberate
voiceLines.text: Understood. I am activating CIRP 2 now. I will notify the Board and the Secretary of State’s office. I confirm the directive.
